sectionTwelveThirteenAnswer.question: Is the delivered state -- Section 12 unanswered, Section 13 populated -- correct on the expungement packets?
sectionTwelveThirteenAnswer.answer: No. It is a defect on both expungement families, and the form's own printed text plus the packet's own proposed Order settle it without needing the builder's reading.
reasoning: The two page-level instructions are not the same instruction. Page 1 says 'If you are only requesting to seal criminal records, do not fill out this section' -- leave it blank. Page 4 says 'If you are only requesting to expunge cases, check the “No” box in Section 12, skip to the bottom of the form and sign it' -- make a mark. The delivered packets treat both as 'leave blank'. The asymmetry is the form's, not an inference.

The route registry makes the answer route-determined. obligation:track-pathway:IL:il-exp-nonconv:adult-non-conviction-expungement is 'Expunging an arrest or charge that did not end in a conviction' and obligation:track-pathway:IL:il-exp-qualprob:expungement-after-eligible-supervision-or-qualified-probation is 'Expunging a case that ended in qualified probation you completed'. Neither carries any sealing authority. So the field map's declaration of '12 - Seal Records' as refusalClass participant_sworn_narrative_or_legal_election with routeDetermined:false is wrong: what is being requested is what the route is.

The delivered state is worse than an unmade election, because Section 13 is filled in. The packet does not merely fail to say whether it wants sealing; it asks the court to seal 2021-CF-004217 while refusing to answer the question that authorises the request.

The packet contradicts itself in the same envelope. EXP-AD Order Granting Section 1 (EXPUNGEMENT) carries 2021-CF-004217 and Section 2 (SEALING), whose printed instruction is 'Enter the arrest or case number for all cases or charges listed under Section 13 of the Request form', is blank. The proposed Order says expungement-only; the Request's Section 13 says otherwise.

The two seal families are the control. il-seal-2yr-set and il-seal-3yr-set tick Section 12 Yes and populate Section 13, and leave Section 1 blank per the page-1 wording. That is the correct shape for a seal-only route, and it shows the builder's check() helper reaching /Yes is sufficient for the seal side while leaving the expunge side with no way to say No.

The builder's own reading was right about what correct looks like -- expunge-only should read No and skip 13 -- and right that the delivered state fits neither reading. It fits neither because it is a defect, not because the form is ambiguous.
